The '''276th Imperial TIE Bomber Group''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] group whose [[TIE pilot|pilots]] flew [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]].

==Description==
The 276th Imperial flew [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] that were [[Color/Legends|colored]] with the standard [[Color/Legends|gray]] of the Empire. Armed with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]], they were configured to sacrifice weapons strength for increased maneuverability and target accuracy. This was in contrast to their contemporary squadron, the [[323rd Imperial TIE Bomber Group|323rd Imperial]].<ref name="Mini">{{PocketModel|set=Ground Assault|cardname=276th Imperial TIE bomber|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipga03b.jpg}}</ref>
